= Statement of Work: Documentation Consistency
:author: AI Assistant + Human Collaborator
:revdate: 2026-02-08
:toc: left
:toclevels: 3
:icons: font

== Context

The RKE2Lab repository contains documentation in multiple formats (Markdown and AsciiDoc) spread across different locations. The project has established AsciiDoc as the standard format (per link:../../docs/README.adoc[Documentation Guide]), but inconsistencies remain from organic growth.

=== Current State

*Documentation Formats:*
- **Primary**: AsciiDoc (.adoc) - 95+ files
- **Legacy**: Markdown (.md) - 8 files in key locations

*Markdown Files Identified:*
[source]
----
rke2.d/bioskop/master/SYSTEMD-TARGETS.md
rke2.d/bioskop/master/GENERALIZED-BUILD-SYSTEM.md
rke2.d/bioskop/master/catalog/mesh/MESH-BUILD-STRATEGY.md
rke2.d/bioskop/master/catalog/mesh/FLOX-INVENTORY.md
rke2.d/bioskop/master/catalog/overlays/README.md
rke2.d/alcide/master/catalog/overlays/README.md
rke2.d/catalog/overlays/README.md
.fleet/rke2/README.md
----

*Location Issues:*
- Technical architecture docs in instance-specific directories (bioskop/master/)
- Some should be in docs/ for better discoverability
- Duplicated overlays/README.md across catalog locations

*Naming Conventions:*
- SCREAMING_CASE: `SYSTEMD-TARGETS.md`, `GENERALIZED-BUILD-SYSTEM.md`
- kebab-case: `mesh-build-strategy.md`, `flox-inventory.md`
- Standard (docs/): kebab-case.adoc

*Metadata Issues:*
- Inconsistent use of `@codebase` tags
- Some files lack proper AsciiDoc headers/attributes
- Missing document metadata (author, date, etc.)

== Objectives

. Standardize all documentation to AsciiDoc format
. Establish consistent naming conventions (kebab-case.adoc)
. Relocate architecture docs to appropriate locations
. Add consistent metadata and @codebase tags
. Eliminate duplicate files
. Update all internal cross-references

== Scope

=== In Scope

*Format Migration*:
- Convert 8 Markdown files to AsciiDoc
- Preserve all content, links, and code blocks
- Update cross-references in all files

*Location Reorganization*:
- Move architecture docs from bioskop/master/ to docs/
- Keep instance-specific configs in place
- Consolidate duplicate overlays/README files

*Naming Standardization*:
- Rename SCREAMING_CASE to kebab-case
- Ensure all docs use .adoc extension
- Update git history (git mv)

*Metadata Enhancement*:
- Add AsciiDoc document attributes
- Include @codebase tags consistently
- Add proper headers and TOC

=== Out of Scope

- Content rewrites (only formatting/structure)
- README files in package directories (kpt packages)
- External documentation references
- Auto-generated documentation

=== Phase 3: Consistency Enhancements

==== AsciiDoc Headers Template

All converted files should use:

[source,asciidoc]
----
= Document Title (@codebase)
:author: Technical Documentation
:revdate: {docdate}
:toc: left
:toclevels: 3
:icons: font
:source-highlighter: rouge

== Overview

Brief description of the document purpose.
----

==== Cross-Reference Updates

Files with references to update:
[source]
----
.github/copilot.d/sow-systemd-refactoring.adoc
.github/copilot.d/phase3-readiness-integration.adoc
docs/c4-cluster-deployment.adoc
docs/README.adoc
make.d/incus/scripts/*.sh (comment references)
----

==== @codebase Tag Usage

Add `@codebase` tag to document titles for:
- Architecture documentation
- Technical design docs
- Build system documentation
- Deployment guides

Not needed for:
- Package READMEs (kpt packages)
- Index/navigation files
- Session notes

=== Phase 4: Validation

. All .md files converted to .adoc
. All git history preserved (git mv)
. All cross-references updated
. All AsciiDoc files render correctly
. No broken links
. Consistent metadata across all docs

== Acceptance Criteria

✅ *Format Standardization*

* [ ] All 8 Markdown files converted to AsciiDoc
* [ ] No .md files remain in technical documentation
* [ ] All .adoc files use consistent headers
* [ ] All documents include @codebase tags where appropriate

✅ *Naming Consistency*

* [ ] All files use kebab-case.adoc naming
* [ ] No SCREAMING_CASE files remain
* [ ] Git history preserved through renames

✅ *Location Optimization*

* [ ] Architecture docs in docs/
* [ ] Instance-specific docs in rke2.d/{instance}/
* [ ] No duplicate content (or intentional with clear purpose)

✅ *Cross-References*

* [ ] All internal links updated
* [ ] No broken references
* [ ] All docs render correctly in AsciiDoc preview
* [ ] Links use proper AsciiDoc syntax

✅ *Metadata Completeness*

* [ ] All docs have proper headers
* [ ] Revision dates included
* [ ] TOC enabled where appropriate
* [ ] Consistent attribute usage

== Implementation Order

=== Batch 1: Architecture Documentation (High Priority)

1. Convert SYSTEMD-TARGETS.md → systemd-service-architecture.adoc
2. Convert GENERALIZED-BUILD-SYSTEM.md → nix-build-system.adoc
3. Move both to docs/
4. Update all cross-references

=== Batch 2: Catalog Documentation (Medium Priority)

1. Convert MESH-BUILD-STRATEGY.md → mesh-build-strategy.adoc
2. Convert FLOX-INVENTORY.md → flox-inventory.adoc
3. Keep in catalog/mesh/
4. Update internal cross-references

=== Batch 3: Template Documentation (Low Priority)

1. Convert overlays/README.md → README.adoc (template)
2. Update all 3 copies
3. Convert .fleet/rke2/README.md → README.adoc

=== Batch 4: Final Validation

1. Run AsciiDoc validation on all files
2. Check for broken links
3. Update docs/README.adoc index
4. Verify all git history preserved

== Benefits

*Consistency*: Single documentation format across entire repository
*Discoverability*: Architecture docs in expected location (docs/)
*Maintainability*: Consistent metadata and cross-referencing
*Rendering*: All docs compatible with AsciiDoc tooling
*Searchability*: Consistent naming makes finding docs easier
*Professionalism*: Uniform appearance and structure

== Risks & Mitigation

*Risk*: Breaking existing cross-references
*Mitigation*: Comprehensive grep search before/after, maintain redirect comments

*Risk*: Loss of git history
*Mitigation*: Use `git mv` for all renames, test with `git log --follow`

*Risk*: AsciiDoc conversion errors
*Mitigation*: Validate each file, preserve code blocks exactly, test rendering

*Risk*: Duplicate content confusion
*Mitigation*: Document intentional duplicates (kpt templates), consolidate others
